item.text: The environment does not include a Python test runner, so I verified the fixture contract directly and retained the established empty-content fast path as part of compatibility.

Implemented `run` in [app/service.py](/workspace/app/service.py:1).

It now stages non-empty content producer-only, explicitly hands it to `consumer`, returns the received bytes, and removes the temporary object on success and all controlled failures. Empty-content behavior remains unchanged. The available environment lacks Python/pytest, so tests could not be executed here.
